title: The Village and The Newspaper
author: George Crabbe

authorInfo.bio: George Crabbe (1754–1832) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Village and The Newspaper" by George Crabbe is a poetic work composed during the early 19th century, specifically in the context of Romantic literature. The book explores the harsh realities of rural life, focusing on the struggles of the impoverished village population, while also critiquing the impact of newspapers on society and literature.
